2609.06835.title: Skynet: Workflow-Level Anomaly Detection for Agentic AI via Semantic and Structural Modeling
2609.06835.paper_summary: Agentic AI systems execute complex tasks through long-horizon workflows of planning, tool use, and multi-agent coordination. Task failures in these systems often originate from a single step, such as an injected prompt or a flawed plan, and are then amplified through downstream dependencies as the corrupted step propagates across many subsequent agents and tool calls. Existing defenses either target a specific class of attacks or failures, or inspect individual prompts and steps in isolation. Both leave the global dependency structure of a workflow unexamined, and miss the inconsistencies that only emerge when the execution is viewed as a whole. We argue that anomaly detection for agentic AI must reason at the workflow level, where global execution structure exposes signals that local checks cannot see. We present Skynet, a principled workflow-level anomaly detection framework that turns observed multi-agent execution into directed workflow graphs and scores them against learned benign behavior. Skynet jointly models the semantic execution context and the structural organization of inter-agent delegation, tool invocation, and data-flow dependencies, and trains only on benign workflows. Because training never sees attacks or failures, this design naturally extends to zero-day detection: any execution that violates benign workflow regularities surfaces as off-manifold geometry under a single decision rule. We evaluate Skynet on three public agentic safety and failure benchmarks. It sustains high recall together with a sub-1% false positive rate, with per-workflow and per-step latencies low enough for online monitoring of agentic AI runtimes.
2609.06835.paper_summary_zh: 代理 AI 系統通過長期的規劃、工具使用和多代理協調工作流程執行複雜任務。這些系統中的任務失敗通常源於單一步驟，例如注入的提示或有缺陷的計劃，然後隨著受損步驟在許多後續代理和工具調用中傳播而被放大。現有的防禦措施要麼針對特定類別的攻擊或失敗，要麼孤立地檢查單個提示和步驟。這兩者都未檢查工作流程的全局依賴結構，並且錯過了只有在將執行視為整體時才會出現的不一致性。我們主張，代理 AI 的異常檢測必須在工作流程層面進行推理，因為全局執行結構暴露出局部檢查無法看到的信號。我們提出 Skynet，一個原則性的工作流程層級異常檢測框架，將觀察到的多代理執行轉化為有向工作流程圖，並根據學習到的良性行為對其進行評分。Skynet 共同建模語義執行上下文和代理之間的委派、工具調用和數據流依賴的結構組織，並僅在良性工作流程上進行訓練。由於訓練從未見過攻擊或失敗，這一設計自然擴展到零日檢測：任何違反良性工作流程規律的執行在單一決策規則下會顯現為異常幾何。我們在三個公共代理安全和失敗基準上評估 Skynet。它保持高召回率，同時假陽性率低於 1%，每個工作流程和每個步驟的延遲足夠低，以便在線監控代理 AI 的運行時。
